authors.why: One row per author keyed by au_id with name, phone and address; titleauthor points at it.

discounts.why: Three discount schemes, unique by discounttype, with quantity bands and a discount amount, one tied to a store; amounts describe the scheme, so not a pure label.

employee.why: One row per employee keyed by emp_id, pointing at jobs and publishers; hire_date is a business date.

jobs.why: 14 job descriptions keyed by job_id with the level range each allows, pointed at only by employee.

pub_info.why: One row per publisher keyed by pub_id (a unique pointer to publishers) with a logo and PR text, a one-to-one extension of publishers.

publishers.why: Eight publishers keyed by pub_id with name and location; titles, employee and pub_info point at it.

roysched.why: Royalty bands per title (title_id with a low and high sales range and a royalty rate); no time column and one pointer, so attribute rows of titles keyed by title and range.

sales.why: One row per title on a store order, stamped with ord_date, pointing at stores and titles.

stores.why: Six bookshops keyed by stor_id with name and address; sales and discounts point at it.

titleauthor.why: Many-to-many link of au_id and title_id, keyed by the pair, with author order and royalty share on the link.

titles.why: One row per book keyed by title_id, pointing at publishers; sales, titleauthor and roysched point at it; pubdate is a business date.
